This is Sinder Deal Desk. One workspace for cross-border trade, from the first signal of demand to a priced, approved offer.

It starts with opportunity. The desk scans public tenders and procurement projects around the world, matches them to products, and lays out every route to the deal: bid directly, through an agent, with a local partner, or as a supplier to the winner.

Next, suppliers. Search for any product, and the desk returns manufacturers and traders with the evidence behind each match. Mark a result as relevant or not, and every future search learns from your call.

Then, the price. The commodity prices tab tracks physical prices by origin and grade, from official boards, exchanges and auctions worldwide. Coffee from Uganda, palm oil from Malaysia, fertilizer, fuel and freight. Each one shown as published, and in dollars per tonne.

Now, the bid. The simulator finds the duty, freight and other costs for the route. Slide the offer price, and watch the expected profit and the chance to win move together, until the desk tells you whether the bid is worth making.
Ready to buy? Request quotations straight from the panel, sent from the Sinder mailbox, with a confirmation step and a full log of every message.

And when you want a deal run end to end, open the deal agent in Telegram. It researches suppliers and tenders, works the numbers, and drafts every message. Nothing goes out until you tap approve, and every link opens the right page in the desk.
Evidence before claims. Your approval before any commitment. Sinder Deal Desk, at desk dot sinder dot pro.
